       PROGRAM-ID. CMA7Q1.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-SATISFACTORY-RESPONSE PIC X VALUE 'Y'.
       01  WS-CALENDAR-MONTH-PASSED PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       01  WS-OMBUDSMAN-OPTION      PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       1000-MAIN.
           ACCEPT WS-SATISFACTORY-RESPONSE

           DISPLAY WS-OMBUDSMAN-OPTION
           STOP RUN.

       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.

       01  WS-PROFIT-PCT            PIC 9(3)V99 VALUE ZERO.

           END-IF
           DISPLAY WS-IS-BO
           STOP RUN.

authority.text: For partnership firms, the beneficial owner is the natural person with ownership of/entitlement to more than 10 percent of capital or profits (lowered from 15 percent by the 2023-10-17 amendment to the 2016 MD).

Where the customer is a partnership firm, the beneficial owner is the natural person(s), who, whether acting alone or together, or through one or more juridical person, has/have ownership of/entitlement to more than 15 per cent of capital or profits of the partnership.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. KYC7A1.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-PERIODIC-UPDATION    PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       01  WS-UPDATED-INFO-RECEIVED PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       01  WS-CUSTOMER-ID           PIC X(16) VALUE SPACES.
       01  WS-REGISTRY-STATUS       PIC X(8) VALUE 'NOT-SENT'.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       1000-MAIN.
           ACCEPT WS-PERIODIC-UPDATION
           ACCEPT WS-UPDATED-INFO-RECEIVED
           ACCEPT WS-CUSTOMER-ID
           IF WS-PERIODIC-UPDATION = 'Y' OR
              WS-UPDATED-INFO-RECEIVED = 'Y'
              PERFORM 2000-UPLOAD-REGISTRY
           END-IF
           DISPLAY WS-REGISTRY-STATUS
           STOP RUN.
       2000-UPLOAD-REGISTRY.
           IF WS-CUSTOMER-ID NOT = SPACES
              MOVE 'UPLOADED' TO WS-REGISTRY-STATUS
           END-IF.

authority.text: Regulated entities must update KYC records in the Central KYC Records Registry within 7 days of receiving updated information from a customer.

ABSENCE (old side is the absence of any update-deadline): clause (h) required uploading/updating KYC data at periodic updation or when updated information was received, with NO time-bound deadline. The seven-day sentence carries footnote 148: 'Inserted vide circular DOR.AML.REC.49/14.01.001/2024-25 dated November 6, 2024' - 'Inserted', not 'Amended': the sentence had no predecessor in any form.
